title: MAMATA BAL SADAN - SASWAD, ORPHANAGE FOR GIRLS
heroText: Established in 1994 at Kumbharvalan (Saswad), Purandar, Dist. Pune HOD - Mr. Deepak Gaikwad who is Maai's first ever adopted son, Current Beneficiaries : 75
points: Provide the basic necessities of food, shelter, cloth and medical care.
Motivates and supports orphan girls to get educated, learn vocational skills and helping them for their professional career.
To shape personal life by finding proper alliances and arranging marriages. The institute sees that its children are properly settled in their life and leading a stable life.
